name: SNC80
summary: SNC-80 is an opioid analgesic compound that selectively activates μ–δ opioid receptor heteromers and is used primarily in scientific research. Discovered in 1994, SNC-80 was a pioneering non-peptide compound regarded as a highly selective agonist for the δ-opioid receptor.

pharmacology.text: SNC-80 is an opioid analgesic compound that selectively activates μ–δ opioid receptor heteromers and is used primarily in scientific research. Discovered in 1994, SNC-80 was a pioneering non-peptide compound regarded as a highly selective agonist for the δ-opioid receptor. SNC-80 was the first non-peptide compound developed that was regarded as a highly selective agonist for the δ-opioid receptor.

uses.text: SNC-80 is an opioid analgesic compound that selectively activates μ–δ opioid receptor heteromers and is used primarily in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. In animal studies, SNC80 and similar delta opioid agonists can trigger seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。在動物實驗中，SNC80及類似的δ鴉片受體促效劑可能引發癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。在动物实验中，SNC80及类似的δ鸦片受体促效剂可能引发癫痫发作。

fact.en: Discovered in 1994, it was one of the first non-peptide drugs found to act selectively on delta opioid receptors, which made it a key research tool for studying them.
fact.zh: 它在1994年被發現，是最早能選擇性作用於δ鴉片受體的非胜肽藥物之一，因此成為研究這類受體的重要工具。
fact.zhHans: 它在1994年被发现，是最早能选择性作用于δ鸦片受体的非胜肽药物之一，因此成为研究这类受体的重要工具。
